title: Overwhelming Force - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Overwhelming Force trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Overwhelming Force phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: One weapon only. The cap is 30 for every weapon, so this is a materials question rather than a choice about which blade.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 27 of 36 on the list - before it A Tempered Ten · after it Listen to Every Flower. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
